results.name: weapon_get_trigger_recovery_fraction
results.evidence: Reads per-trigger effect-state byte at object+trigger*0x28+0x261; state 2 returns 1-(short counter/30)/tag duration field(+0x48 in triggers reflexive), state 3 returns 1.0, else 0.0.
results.summary: Computes a 0..1 recovery/charge fraction for one weapon trigger's timed effect state, used for HUD/animation blending.

results.name: weapon_trigger_can_fire
results.evidence: Interpolates the trigger's min/max rate-of-fire tag fields by current heat, converts to a 30Hz tick threshold, compares against a per-trigger age counter, and returns a packed ready/charged-lock flag.
results.summary: Evaluates whether a weapon trigger has aged long enough (given its rate-of-fire and heat) to fire again, returning a packed ready/lock flag.

results.name: weapon_trigger_update
results.evidence: Looks up the trigger's magazine link, checks the berserk flag (object+0x8b&1) and a FUN_0053ed60 'can act' gate, then either fires directly via FUN_004c3f10, defers via the reload/idle helpers FUN_004c47d0/FUN_004c49c0, based on ammo/heat thresholds.
results.summary: Per-tick decision routine for a weapon trigger that fires it, forces a reload, or plays an idle/overheat cue depending on ammo and heat state.

results.name: weapon_trigger_notify_reload_begin
results.evidence: Fetches a network id via hash_table_get, packs the trigger's rounds-left/rounds-total fields (offsets 0x2b6, 0xae) into a local struct and posts it through FUN_004ec940(...,0x2b,...) then FUN_004e1a80, the same shape used by the sibling 0x2d/0x2e event senders; called from weapon_trigger_begin_reload.
results.summary: Packages a trigger's current ammo counts into a network/UI event (id 0x2b) and dispatches it when a reload begins.

results.name: weapon_apply_predicted_trigger_ammo
results.evidence: Gated on FUN_004ec590 (network prediction check) and object_try_and_get(4); writes rounds-left/loaded fields at player+0x2d4/0x2d8 and sets a 'dirty' bit (|8) in flags+0x22c.
results.summary: Writes a client-predicted ammo count into the local player's copy of a weapon trigger and marks it dirty pending server confirmation.

results.name: weapon_trigger_begin_reload
results.evidence: Checks the trigger's magazine chamber state (0 or 2) and that no berserk/other-state flags (0x261,0x289,0x238) are set, picks a reload amount via FUN_004c2f80 depending on host/client mode (DAT_00719720==2), sets magazine state to 1 (loading), clears the berserk bit, and on the host path calls weapon_trigger_notify_reload_begin.
results.summary: Starts loading a fresh round into a weapon trigger's chamber/magazine, choosing the load amount for host vs client and notifying observers.

results.name: weapon_trigger_notify_reload_end
results.evidence: Identical packaging/dispatch shape to weapon_trigger_notify_reload_begin (0x4c3470) but posts event id 0x2d instead of 0x2b; called from weapon_trigger_reload_tick when a reload step completes on the host.
results.summary: Packages a trigger's ammo counts and dispatches a network/UI event (id 0x2d) signalling that a reload step has finished.

results.name: weapon_apply_corrected_trigger_ammo
results.evidence: Mirrors weapon_apply_predicted_trigger_ammo's gating (FUN_004ec590/object_try_and_get(4)) but writes to player+0x2b0 array and clears the dirty bit (&~8) instead of setting it.
results.summary: Applies a server-confirmed ammo correction to a weapon trigger and clears the pending-prediction dirty flag.

results.name: weapon_trigger_reload_tick
results.evidence: Clamps the newly-chambered round count to the magazine's capacity field (magazine+10), then either calls weapon_trigger_begin_reload again (more rounds to load) or, on the host, calls weapon_trigger_notify_reload_end and sets the item's 'ammo changed' flag (0x4000000).
results.summary: Advances a one-round-at-a-time reload for a trigger, either loading another round or finishing the reload and notifying observers.

results.name: weapon_trigger_reload_tick_predicted
results.evidence: Same chamber-count clamping/rounding logic as weapon_trigger_reload_tick but with no network notification calls, matching a client-side predicted variant.
results.summary: Client-predicted counterpart of the reload tick: advances the chambered round count locally without posting network events.

results.name: weapon_trigger_start_unload
results.evidence: When the trigger's magazine state is idle/ready (0 or 2) and no berserk/other-state flags are set, calls the effect helper (index+3) and sets magazine state to 3 with the current tick as timestamp.
results.summary: Begins an 'unload'-style state transition for a trigger's magazine, timestamping the change and playing the associated effect.

results.name: weapon_trigger_start_reload_effect
results.evidence: Stamps the trigger's effect-state byte to 3 with the current tick, invokes the effect helper with index+7 (the same offset used for full reload begin), and plays a sound/animation permutation (id 0xe), aborting via FUN_00492990 if none was found.
results.summary: Starts the visual/audio 'reload' effect state for a trigger and plays its associated sound permutation.

results.name: weapon_trigger_continue_burst
results.evidence: Refires (FUN_004c3f10) when more rounds remain in the current magazine (unaff_EBX+1 < magazine count field), then always stamps the trigger's effect state to 1 with the current tick.
results.summary: Continues a multi-round burst by firing again if rounds remain and marking the trigger's effect state as 'in burst'.

results.name: weapon_trigger_effect_update_heat
results.evidence: If the trigger tag's heat-recovery field (+0x58) is positive, stamps effect state 6 (overheat) with the current tick and clears a per-trigger counter (+0x9c); otherwise, if more than one magazine exists, re-fires via FUN_004c3f10(...,1) and clears the effect-state bytes/short to zero.
results.summary: Updates a trigger's effect state for heat-related recovery, entering an 'overheat' state or clearing it and possibly continuing fire.

results.name: weapon_trigger_handle_empty_recovery
results.evidence: Reads a per-trigger tag field (@+0x50) and dispatches to weapon_trigger_reload_recovery (value 1) or weapon_trigger_effect_update_heat (value 2).
results.summary: Dispatches trigger-empty handling to either the reload-recovery or heat-recovery path based on the trigger's tag-defined recovery type.

results.name: weapon_trigger_effect_reset
results.evidence: Clears the effect-state byte/short (offset+0x261/0x262) for a given trigger index to 0/0; called with a fixed trigger of 0 from weapon_trigger_begin_reload.
results.summary: Clears a weapon trigger's effect state back to idle.

results.name: weapon_trigger_effect_set_empty
results.evidence: Sets a trigger's effect-state byte to 7 and counter to 0xffff, the same sentinel values weapon_fire_trigger uses to mark 'no ammo'.
results.summary: Marks a trigger's effect state as 'out of ammo' (state 7, sentinel counter).

results.name: weapon_trigger_effect_full_reset
results.evidence: Clears an item-wide field at offset 0x250 to -1 in addition to zeroing the given trigger's effect-state byte/short, unlike the narrower weapon_trigger_effect_reset.
results.summary: Fully resets a weapon trigger's effect state along with an item-wide field (likely an attachment/zoom reference).

results.name: weapon_fire_trigger
results.evidence: Resolves ammo consumption against the magazine, computes a misfire/jam probability from tag fields (+0x448/0x44c) using random_real, calls trigger_create_projectiles to spawn the round, applies self-damage via object_apply_damage on backfire, and sets the trigger's effect state to 5/7 depending on remaining ammo.
results.summary: Core per-tick routine that fires one round of a weapon trigger: consumes ammo, resolves misfires/overheat, spawns projectiles, and updates trigger effect state.

results.name: weapon_play_trigger_tag_effect
results.evidence: Resolves the tag referenced by a trigger slot and compares its tag-group FourCC to the multichar literal 'effe' (effect group) to call FUN_004507a0, or 'snd!' (sound group) to call FUN_00450630/FUN_00543ce0.
results.summary: Plays whichever tag (sound or effect) is referenced by a weapon trigger slot, at the item's owning object.

results.name: weapon_stop_trigger_tag_effect
results.evidence: Same owner-resolution preamble as weapon_play_trigger_tag_effect but calls FUN_004506d0 with sentinel (-1,-1) arguments instead of dispatching on tag group.
results.summary: Stops/clears whatever sound or effect is currently playing for a weapon trigger's owning object.

results.name: weapon_trigger_effect_clear_after_fire
results.evidence: Identical body to weapon_trigger_effect_reset (0x4c3e40), but called from weapon_fire_trigger's default (no-chamber-bit) branch after resolving a shot.
results.summary: Clears a trigger's effect state to idle after resolving a fired shot.

results.name: weapon_trigger_reload_recovery
results.evidence: Plays the trigger's tag effect (weapon_play_trigger_tag_effect) then dispatches to a biped-specific (FUN_004f5aa0) and/or vehicle-specific (FUN_004f59d0) reload-recovery routine based on the owning object's type field.
results.summary: Runs the post-reload recovery step for a trigger, invoking a holder-type-specific finish routine.

results.name: weapon_trigger_effect_set_state
results.evidence: Simple setter writing a caller-supplied state byte and counter short into a trigger's effect-state struct (offset+0x261/0x262); used by weapon_trigger_update to arm the overheat/empty cues.
results.prototype: void __cdecl weapon_trigger_effect_set_state(short trigger_index, char state, short counter)
results.summary: Sets a weapon trigger's effect-state byte and timer counter to caller-supplied values.

results.name: weapon_trigger_notify_reload_cancel
results.evidence: Same packaging/dispatch shape as weapon_trigger_notify_reload_begin/_end but posts event id 0x2e; called from weapon_resync_trigger_state when a pending reload is aborted rather than continued.
results.summary: Packages a trigger's ammo counts and dispatches a network/UI event (id 0x2e) signalling a cancelled/host-completed reload.

results.name: weapon_apply_ammo_correction
results.evidence: Mirrors weapon_apply_corrected_trigger_ammo's gating (FUN_004ec590/object_try_and_get(4)) but also resolves an index into a lookup table and follows up with weapon_resync_trigger_state.
results.summary: Applies a server ammo correction for a weapon trigger, then resynchronizes any in-progress reload state.

results.name: weapon_resync_trigger_state
results.evidence: Marks every trigger's effect state to 8 for the item, then for each magazine still in the 'loading' state (1) checks a threshold via FUN_004c2f80 to either continue (weapon_trigger_reload_tick) or cancel/finish (weapon_trigger_notify_reload_cancel) the reload, finally clearing the magazine state.
results.summary: Resynchronizes a weapon's trigger/magazine reload states, used after a network ammo correction is applied.

results.name: trigger_create_projectiles
results.evidence: Existing name is backed by the referenced strings 'primary trigger'/'secondary trigger' used to index the fired trigger, and by calls to object_new_with_datum_role_control plus vector3d_normalize_with_length/vector3d_cross_product/vector3d_build_perpendicular and unit_get_camera_position to compute spread and spawn transforms.
results.summary: Computes the firing origin/spread for a weapon's trigger and spawns the resulting projectile object(s).

results.name: weapon_get_barrel_spread_offset
results.evidence: Computes an index-based angular offset (even/odd distribution around the barrel count) then rotates a vector by sin/cos of that offset scaled by param_4 via vector3d_rotate_about_axis, matching a multi-barrel projectile spread pattern.
results.summary: Computes the rotated spread offset vector for one barrel of a multi-barrel weapon trigger, used when spawning projectiles.

results.name: weapon_update_state_indicator_flags
results.evidence: Reads the item's state field (+0x238) and, for states 3/4, checks associated tag/battery fields before setting one of two float indicator flags (+0x9d or +0xa7) to 1.0.
results.summary: Sets one of two indicator flags on the item depending on its current weapon state and associated tag threshold fields.

results.name: weapon_check_state_and_reset_mode
results.evidence: Reads the item state field (+0x238) and, unless it falls in a small allowed range (7,8,10), calls weapon_set_state(0,1) to force it back to the default mode.
results.summary: Validates the item's current weapon state and forces it back to the default mode if it isn't one of the allowed 'settled' states.

results.name: weapon_set_state
results.evidence: Translates a trigger/action index (0-10) through a fixed lookup table into an animation-label index, verifies it exists in the item's model-animation tag block, picks a random permutation via FUN_004d6280, and writes it into the item's mode field (byte offset 0x238) while resetting a sub-index (+0xd2).
results.summary: Transitions a weapon item into a new named state/animation mode, selecting a matching animation permutation from its tag data.

results.name: weapon_set_ammo_counts
results.evidence: Iterates every magazine, clamps a caller-supplied desired-count array against each magazine's capacity field (magazine+10), and writes the clamped values into the item's rounds-left fields (offset+0x2b6 stride 0xc and offset+0xae stride 4).
results.summary: Sets each magazine's loaded ammo count from a caller-supplied array, clamped to each magazine's capacity.

results.name: weapon_set_loaded_ammo_fraction
results.evidence: Clamps the input to [0,1]; if the weapon has no ammo-consuming magazines it writes the battery/heat field (+0x90) to (1-fraction), otherwise it computes and writes a rounded loaded-round count for magazine 0 and adjusts the total rounds-left field accordingly.
results.summary: Sets a weapon's ammo or battery level from a 0..1 fraction, used by scripted/cheat ammo-setting code.

results.name: item_build_state_sync_message
results.evidence: Resolves several network ids via hash_table_get (falling back to FUN_004e9c20 to create one), then copies the item's position/orientation-like fields (0x1d-0x22, 0xb9-0xc3) and ammo fields (0xae/0xb1) into a scratch struct passed to FUN_004ec940 with message id 0x20.
results.summary: Builds and dispatches a network synchronization message carrying an item's transform, orientation and ammo state.

results.name: item_new_from_replication_data
results.evidence: Gated by FUN_004ec590 (network acceptance check), computes cross products/normalizations for the item's basis vectors, spawns the object via object_new_with_datum_role_control, then copies position/velocity/orientation and ammo-state fields (0x2b6/0x2c2/0x240) from the message into the new object.
results.summary: Creates a new item object from a replicated network creation message and initializes its transform and ammo state.

results.name: item_send_network_update
results.evidence: Resolves a network id and, depending on param_4 (0/1), packages either a minimal ammo update or a full transform+ammo update, dispatching it through a per-tag-type send routine looked up via ((&PTR_PTR_0069bfdc)[tag_type])[+0x10], incrementing a wraparound sequence-number byte on success.
results.summary: Sends an incremental or full network state update for an item, using a per-tag-type dispatch table and a sequence counter.

results.name: item_apply_network_update
results.evidence: Compares the incoming message's sequence/type bytes against the item's own (+0x2e1/+0x2e2) and discards stale updates via FUN_004ec670; otherwise copies the payload's transform into the item's position/velocity/orientation fields and, if the item moved far enough or is networked-owned, calls FUN_004f52c0 (a physics/placement refresh).
results.summary: Applies an incoming network state update to an item object if it is newer than the item's current state, refreshing its transform and ammo fields.

results.name: console_flag_init_and_check
results.evidence: Initializes several globals (including the literal 0x6f6c6168 = 'halo' as a 4-byte tag) before scanning the process command line for '-console' and setting DAT_006b7021 accordingly; shares its tail exactly with the next two functions.
results.summary: Initializes a block of globals and then scans argv for the '-console' flag, setting a global console-enabled flag.

results.name: console_flag_check_from_registers
results.evidence: Inherited name 'weapon_prevents_grenade_throwing' is unsupported: the body has no relation to weapons or grenades and instead repeats the exact '-console' argv scan and global-init pattern seen in FUN_004c62d0/0x4c6340, reading its inputs from raw in_ECX/in_EDX registers rather than named parameters.
results.summary: Re-initializes the same globals and re-scans argv for '-console', setting the console-enabled flag; the previous 'grenade throwing' name did not match the code.

results.name: console_flag_check_tail
results.evidence: Inherited name 'weapon_get_first_person_animation_time' is unsupported: the body uses uninitialized-looking registers (in_CX, unaff_ESI, in_ZF/in_SF/in_OF) instead of real parameters and performs the identical '-console' argv scan seen in the two prior functions, with no reference to animation timing.
results.summary: Fragment that repeats the '-console' command-line scan and sets the console flag; the inherited 'animation time' name is not supported by the decompiled code.
